greeting.text: Hah! Fresh blood! I'm Mereoleona Vermillion. Don't bow, it makes my neck hurt.
You look like you can take a punch. Good. I've been bored.
Are you strong? No, don't answer. I'll find out.
THAT'S you? The one clearing the guardians? Come here, let me see your arms!
Oh, it's you again. Have you been training?
Ha! Still in one piece. Excellent!

hint.text: Mana Zone! Learn it! If you can't feel the magic around you, you're fighting blind, and I will laugh at you.
Mana Strike is raw power with no tricks. I like it. It works on anything, and nobody can call it cheating.
Talking won't make you stronger. Training will. Go hit something big!
Retreat? Never. Fall back to a Safe Zone and come back angrier. That's different.
Fuegoleon thinks too much and Leopold shouts too much. The Crimson Lion is balanced by me, naturally.
Pain is only information. Read it, and move on.
No champions beaten? Hah! Then go beat one. Why are you still talking to me?
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are the first of many. Break them quickly, and keep your anger. It keeps you warm.
You beat Vetto? That monster hit like a mountain. Come here, I'll buy you meat.
A Spade Kingdom brat with gravity? Don't stand where he wants you standing. Move!
Lucius! I'd love to fight someone who reads my moves... and then break his nose with the one he didn't read.
Strangers from other worlds in the Chronicle? Even better! Go, and bring me the strongest one's name.

farewell.text: Go! Don't come back until you've broken something!
Bring me a good story, or a good bruise.
